items.title: 4 Office REITs Paying Dividends Despite the Slump. Which Are Safest?
items.summary: Remote work, looming lease expirations, and costly refinancing hang over office landlords, yet some still pay out yields up to 6%. We tested four dividends against cash earnings to see where the cushion is thick and where one thin payout rests on Manhattan leasing.

items.title: Host Hotels' Q3 FFO Beat Estimates on Strong RevPAR Growth
items.summary: HST's Q3 2026 FFO beat estimates as RevPAR rises 8.8% on strong leisure and business demand, prompting higher full-year earnings and revenue guidance.

items.title: Healthpeak's Q3 FFOA Beat Estimates on Leasing, Senior Housing Growth
items.summary: DOC's Q3 2026 FFOA and revenues beat estimates, driven by solid outpatient leasing and senior housing growth, prompting an upgraded full-year FFOA outlook.

items.title: SBAC Q3 FFO Top Estimates on International Leasing Gains
items.summary: SBA Communications' Q3 2026 FFO beat estimates, driven by strong international leasing growth, even as domestic weakness and lower site development revenues weigh on results.

items.title: Wells Fargo Leads NYC Lenders as Top 20 Originate $36B
items.summary: The 20 biggest NYC lenders originated $36 billion in loans in 12 months, up 57%, but rising yields have cooled deals lately.

items.title: Equinix Q3 AFFO Beat Estimates on Record Bookings, Strong Pricing
items.summary: EQIX's Q3 2026 AFFO beat estimates as record bookings, strong pricing and robust demand fuel revenue growth, prompting a third consecutive guidance hike.

items.title: BXP Doubles Down on Development as It Sells Off Assets
items.summary: BXP says new offices beat acquisitions on returns, with yields near 8% in New York and above 9% in D.C., funded by asset sales.

items.title: VICI Properties' Q3 FFO Meet Estimates, Revenues Beat on Lease Growth
items.summary: VICI's Q3 2026 AFFO meet estimates and revenues beat expectations on lease growth. Strong occupancy and a raised AFFO outlook add to its strength.
